name: Elite Biomedical Solutions
old_description: Since 2012, Elite Biomedical Solutions has delivered an unwavering commitment to quality, safety and reliability. We believe the last thing you should be worried about is a bad part, and that’s why our products are put through rigorous testing to bring you only the very best.
about:
Elite Biomedical Solutions was founded in 2012 in Cincinnati, Ohio, as a family‑owned and operated business dedicated to supplying healthcare organizations with USA‑made replacement parts for clinical equipment. The company began with a focus on infusion and telemetry assets, aiming to eliminate the worry of substandard components.

Today Elite designs, prototypes, validates, and manufactures OEM‑level replacement parts in‑house, using processes that include heat staking, ultrasonic welding, soldering, UV curing, packaging, and validation testing. Its Cincinnati headquarters houses a dedicated training facility and injection‑molding capabilities, while multiple depot repair sites across the country support a range of infusion pumps and syringe modules from brands such as Becton Dickinson, Baxter, B. Braun, and Alaris. The team comprises biomedical, process, and plastics engineers, quality specialists, and certified biomedical equipment technicians.

Customers span individual biomeds, community hospitals, large health systems, and independent service organizations. Elite’s catalog covers hundreds of specific assemblies—rear cases, pressure sensor boards, door assemblies, and battery doors—for devices including the Alaris 8100, Plum A+, CADD Legacy, and Apex Pro lines.

The company emphasizes a values‑driven model built on integrity, quality, and patient safety, offering a one‑year money‑back guarantee on new parts, same‑day shipping for orders placed before 4 p.m. EST, and an average 30 % cost reduction versus OEM pricing. Elite also runs customized BMET training programs at its Cincinnati facility and has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list (2017‑2021) and as a Cincinnati Best Workplace (2021).
